title: America and Britain nearly went to war over a pig
description:
In 1859 the US and Britain came close to war on San Juan Island, and it started with a farmer shooting a pig.

Sources:
- The Pig War — U.S. National Park Service, San Juan Island National Historical Park: https://www.nps.gov/sajh/learn/historyculture/the-pig-war.htm
- Pig War (1859) — Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pig_War_(1859)
